content.comment_body: What does the flashing 'x' in the top right corner of the [product_name] screen mean? I have attached a video clip showing the issue. Thanks.
It indicates that the [product_name] is communicating with the main module.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unsure about the meaning of a flashing 'x' symbol on the [product_name] screen. This uncertainty prevents users from confidently understanding device status, emphasizing the need for more transparent indicators or improved documentation for better usability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward and clear visual signals on the [product_name] screen that accurately reflect device status or problems, eliminating any ambiguity.
